title: Restroom in the back of the alien craft
summary: Charles Hall tells of Restroom in the back of the alien craft, about unspecified at Nevada test site and Area 51, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> In the back of that craft was a restroom.

plain: A man named Charles Hall, who says he served at the Nevada test site near Area 51, a secret US Air Force base in Nevada, describes being inside a craft he says belonged to aliens. His story, played on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, includes a small detail: in the back of the craft there was a restroom. To him, it shows that the beings had ordinary bodily needs, like people.
